name: Sun Taoyong
current_role: Founder, Chairman, Executive Director and CEO, Weimob Inc. (HKEX: 2013)
profile: Sun Taoyong founded Weimob, a Shanghai-based SaaS and digital-marketing company serving merchants (including on WeChat), listed in Hong Kong. He chairs the board and is CEO, overseeing group strategy, and also heads Weimob Development and Weimob International.
interesting_fact: He was named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia list in 2017.
deep_cut_fact: He serves as a deputy to the 8th and 9th Baoshan District People's Congress in Shanghai.
notes: Best route is Weimob investor relations (IR page lists the address for investors, analysts and media).
